questions.stem_md: $1$ dan $476$ gacha bo'lgan natural sonlar orasida nechtasi $9$ ga bo'linadi?
questions.solution_md:
$d$ ga bo'linadigan sonlar $d,2d,3d,\dots$ ko'rinishida; ularning soni $\left[\dfrac{N}{d}\right]$ (butun qismi).

$$\left[\frac{476}{9}\right]=52$$
questions.mistake_note_md: Tipik xato: Bo'linma kasr chiqsa, uni yaxlitlab yuborish (butun qismi o'rniga eng yaqin butunni olish).

ru.stem_md: Сколько натуральных чисел от $1$ до $476$ делятся на $9$?
ru.solution_md:
Числа, делящиеся на $d$, имеют вид $d,2d,3d,\dots$; их количество равно целой части $\left[\dfrac{N}{d}\right]$.

$$\left[\frac{476}{9}\right]=52$$
ru.mistake_note_md: Типичная ошибка: Округлять частное вместо взятия целой части.

kaa.stem_md: $1$ den $476$ ge shekemgi natural sanlardıń neshewi $9$ ge bólinedi?
kaa.solution_md:
$d$ ǵa bólinetuǵın sanlar $d,2d,3d,\dots$ kórinisinde; olardıń sanı $\left[\dfrac{N}{d}\right]$ (pútin bólegi).

$$\left[\frac{476}{9}\right]=52$$
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tipik qátelik: Bólindi bólshek shıqsa, onı jýiklep jiberiw (pútin bólegi ornına eń jaqın pútindi alıw).

en.stem_md: How many natural numbers from $1$ to $476$ are divisible by $9$?
en.solution_md:
Numbers divisible by $d$ are $d,2d,3d,\dots$; their count is the integer part $\left[\dfrac{N}{d}\right]$.

$$\left[\frac{476}{9}\right]=52$$
en.mistake_note_md: Typical mistake: Rounding the quotient instead of taking its integer part.

questions.stem_md: Natural son $3$ ga bo'linganda bo'linma $43$, qoldiq $2$ chiqadi. Shu sonni toping.
questions.solution_md:
Qoldiqli bo'lish formulasi: bo'linuvchi = bo'luvchi $\cdot$ bo'linma + qoldiq.

$$3\cdot 43+2=131$$
questions.mistake_note_md: Tipik xato: Qoldiqni qo'shishni unutish yoki bo'linmani bo'luvchiga qo'shib yuborish.

ru.stem_md: При делении натурального числа на $3$ получили частное $43$ и остаток $2$. Найдите это число.
ru.solution_md:
Формула деления с остатком: делимое = делитель $\cdot$ частное + остаток.

$$3\cdot 43+2=131$$
ru.mistake_note_md: Типичная ошибка: Забыть прибавить остаток или сложить частное с делителем.

kaa.stem_md: Natural san $3$ ge bólingende bólindi $43$, qaldıq $2$ shıqtı. Sol sandı tabıń.
kaa.solution_md:
Qaldıqlı bóliw formulası: bólinwshi = bóliwshi $\cdot$ bólindi + qaldıq.

$$3\cdot 43+2=131$$
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tipik qátelik: Qaldıqtı qosıwdı umıtıw yamasa bólindini bóliwshige qosıp jiberiw.

en.stem_md: A natural number divided by $3$ gives quotient $43$ and remainder $2$. Find the number.
en.solution_md:
Division with remainder: dividend = divisor $\cdot$ quotient + remainder.

$$3\cdot 43+2=131$$
en.mistake_note_md: Typical mistake: Forgetting to add the remainder, or adding the quotient to the divisor.

questions.stem_md: $15$ dan $451$ gacha (chegaralari bilan) bo'lgan natural sonlar orasida nechtasi $5$ ga bo'linadi, lekin $9$ ga bo'linmaydi?
questions.solution_md: $5$ ga bo'linadiganlar: $\lfloor 451/5\rfloor-\lfloor 14/5\rfloor=88$. Ham 5 ga, ham 9 ga bo'linadiganlar 5 va 9 ning EKUK i 45 ga bo'linadi: 10 ta. Javob: $88-10=78$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Ikkala songa bo'linadiganlarni $m\cdot n$ ga bo'linish deb olish (to'g'risi EKUK). Quyi chegarani hisobga olmaslik.

ru.stem_md: Сколько натуральных чисел от $15$ до $451$ (включительно) делятся на $5$, но не делятся на $9$?
ru.solution_md: Делятся на $5$: $\lfloor 451/5\rfloor-\lfloor 14/5\rfloor=88$. Делятся и на 5, и на 9 те, что делятся на НОК 45: 10 шт. Ответ: $88-10=78$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Считать общие кратные как кратные $m\cdot n$ (верно — НОК); не учесть нижнюю границу.

kaa.stem_md: $15$ den $451$ ge shekemgi (shegaraları menen) natural sanlar arasında neshewi $5$ ge bólinedi, biraq $9$ ge bólinbeydi?
kaa.solution_md: $5$ ge bólinetuǵınlar: $\lfloor 451/5\rfloor-\lfloor 14/5\rfloor=88$. 5 ge de, 9 ge de bólinetuǵınlar EKUK 45 ge bólinedi: 10 dana. Juwap: $88-10=78$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Eki sanǵa da bólinetuǵınlardı $m\cdot n$ ge bólinedi dep alıw (durısı EKUK); tómengi shegarasın esapqa almaw.

en.stem_md: How many natural numbers from $15$ to $451$ (inclusive) are divisible by $5$ but not by $9$?
en.solution_md: Divisible by 5: $\lfloor 451/5\rfloor-\lfloor 14/5\rfloor=88$. Divisible by both 5 and 9 means divisible by the LCM 45: 10 numbers. Answer: $88-10=78$.
en.mistake_note_md: Treating common multiples as multiples of $m\cdot n$ (it is the LCM), or ignoring the lower bound.

ru.solution_md: Делятся на $7$: $\lfloor 641/7\rfloor-\lfloor 56/7\rfloor=83$. Делятся и на 7, и на 8 те, что делятся на НОК 56: 10 шт. Ответ: $83-10=73$.

kaa.stem_md: $57$ den $641$ ge shekemgi (shegaraları menen) natural sanlar arasında neshewi $7$ ge bólinedi, biraq $8$ ge bólinbeydi?

kaa.mistake_note_md: Eki sanǵa da bólinetuǵınlardı $m\cdot n$ ge bólinedi dep alıw (durısı EKUK); tómengi shegarasın esapqa almaw.

en.stem_md: How many natural numbers from $57$ to $641$ (inclusive) are divisible by $7$ but not by $8$?
en.solution_md: Divisible by 7: $\lfloor 641/7\rfloor-\lfloor 56/7\rfloor=83$. Divisible by both 7 and 8 means divisible by the LCM 56: 10 numbers. Answer: $83-10=73$.
en.mistake_note_md: Treating common multiples as multiples of $m\cdot n$ (it is the LCM), or ignoring the lower bound.

questions.stem_md: Raqamlari yig'indisi $19$ ga teng bo'lgan eng kichik juft uch xonali natural sonni toping.
questions.solution_md: Raqamlar yig'indisi 19 bo'lishi kerak: chapdagi raqamlarni imkon qadar kichik (birinchisi 1 dan kam emas), oxirgi raqam juftlik shartiga mos tanlanadi. Natija $298$; tekshiruv: $2+9+8=19$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Birinchi raqam $0$ bo'la olmaydi; juftlik/toqlik sharti oxirgi raqamga tegishli. Eng katta va eng kichikni adashtirish ham tez-tez uchraydi.

ru.stem_md: Найдите наименьшее чётное трёхзначное натуральное число с суммой цифр $19$.
ru.solution_md: Сумма цифр должна быть 19: старшие разряды берём как можно меньше (первая цифра не меньше 1), последняя цифра выбирается по условию чётности. Получаем $298$; проверка: $2+9+8=19$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Первая цифра не может быть $0$; чётность определяется последней цифрой. Часто путают наибольшее и наименьшее.

kaa.stem_md: Sanlarınıń qosındısı $19$ ge teń bolǵan eń kishi jup úsh xonalı natural sandı tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: Sanlar qosındısı 19 bolıwı kerek: shep tárepindegi sanlardı mümkin qádar kishi (birinshisi 1 den kem emes), sońǵı san jup-taqlıq shártine say saylanadı. Nátiyje $298$; tekseriw: $2+9+8=19$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Birinshi san $0$ bola almaydı; jup-taqlıq sharti sońǵı sanǵa tiyisli. Eń úlken hám eń kishini shatastırıw da kóp ushırasadı.

en.stem_md: Find the smallest even three-digit natural number whose digits sum to $19$.
en.solution_md: The digit sum must be 19: take the leading digits as small as possible (the first is at least 1), the last digit is chosen by the parity condition. We get $298$; check: $2+9+8=19$.
en.mistake_note_md: The first digit cannot be $0$; parity concerns the last digit. Mixing up largest and smallest is also common.

en.stem_md: Find the largest four-digit natural number whose digits sum to $12$.

kaa.mistake_note_md: Birinshi san $0$ bola almaydı; jup-taqlıq sharti sońǵı sanǵa tiyisli. Eń úlken hám eń kishini shatastırıw da kóp ushırasadı.

en.stem_md: Find the largest even four-digit natural number whose digits sum to $33$.
en.solution_md: The digit sum must be 33: take the leading digits as large as possible (9), the last digit is chosen by the parity condition. We get $9996$; check: $9+9+9+6=33$.
en.mistake_note_md: The first digit cannot be $0$; parity concerns the last digit. Mixing up largest and smallest is also common.

ru.mistake_note_md: Считать только числа, оканчивающиеся на $0$ ($100$, $1000$ содержат несколько нулей); учитывать ведущий ноль.

kaa.stem_md: $1$ den $2468$ ge shekem barlıq natural sanlar izbe-iz jazılǵanda $0$ sanı neshe ret qollanıladı?
kaa.solution_md: Nollerdi razryadlar boyınsha sanaymız: hár bir razryad ushın joqarǵı bólim, házirgi san hám tómengi bólimge qaray esaplanadı. Jámi $686$ nol.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tek $10$ ǵa tamamlanatuǵın sanlardı sanaw ($100$, $1000$ larda bir neshe nol bar) yamasa baslawshı nolge itibar beriw.

en.stem_md: How many times does the digit $0$ appear when all natural numbers from $1$ to $2468$ are written one after another?
en.solution_md: Count zeros position by position, using the higher part, the current digit and the lower part. Total $686$ zeros.
en.mistake_note_md: Counting only numbers ending in $0$ ($100$, $1000$ have several zeros) or counting a leading zero.

ru.mistake_note_md: Считать только числа, оканчивающиеся на $0$ ($100$, $1000$ содержат несколько нулей); учитывать ведущий ноль.

kaa.stem_md: $1$ den $2293$ ge shekem barlıq natural sanlar izbe-iz jazılǵanda $0$ sanı neshe ret qollanıladı?
kaa.solution_md: Nollerdi razryadlar boyınsha sanaymız: hár bir razryad ushın joqarǵı bólim, házirgi san hám tómengi bólimge qaray esaplanadı. Jámi $649$ nol.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tek $10$ ǵa tamamlanatuǵın sanlardı sanaw ($100$, $1000$ larda bir neshe nol bar) yamasa baslawshı nolge itibar beriw.

en.stem_md: How many times does the digit $0$ appear when all natural numbers from $1$ to $2293$ are written one after another?
en.solution_md: Count zeros position by position, using the higher part, the current digit and the lower part. Total $649$ zeros.
en.mistake_note_md: Counting only numbers ending in $0$ ($100$, $1000$ have several zeros) or counting a leading zero.

en.stem_md: How many times does the digit $0$ appear when all natural numbers from $1$ to $1536$ are written one after another?
